list_child.name: lst_decl_books
list_child.desc: This tool retrieves the complete list of customs declarations currently on the books at the brokerage. It is typically used before reviewing clearance progress across the brokerage's workload.

decoys.name: lst_decl_prefile
decoys.desc: This tool retrieves the complete list of customs declarations currently sitting in the pre-filing workspace. It is typically used before transmitting a batch of entries to customs.

decoys.name: lst_decl_amend
decoys.desc: This tool retrieves the complete list of customs declarations currently in the post-entry amendment log. It is typically used before correcting values that customs has already accepted.

decoys.name: lst_decl_drawbk
decoys.desc: This tool retrieves the complete list of customs declarations currently lodged on the duty drawback ledger. It is typically used before preparing a refund claim on exported goods.

get_child.name: get_decl_entry
get_child.desc: This tool fetches the entry record of a single customs declaration using its unique identifier. Use it when a broker needs every field the declaration currently holds.

decoys.name: get_decl_hts
decoys.desc: This tool fetches the tariff classification worksheet of a single customs declaration using its unique identifier. Use it when a broker needs to check the codes applied.

decoys.name: get_decl_docs
decoys.desc: This tool fetches the supporting document packet of a single customs declaration using its unique identifier. Use it when a broker needs the invoice and packing list.

decoys.name: get_decl_duty
decoys.desc: This tool fetches the duty calculation of a single customs declaration using its unique identifier. Use it when a broker needs to confirm the amounts owed on the entry.

list_parent.name: lst_imp_acct
list_parent.desc: This tool returns every importer account registered with the brokerage for customs clearance. It supports lookups by importer name across the whole client base.

decoys.name: lst_imp_bond
decoys.desc: This tool returns every importer account listed on the brokerage's continuous bond register. It supports checks on bond sufficiency before new entries are filed.

decoys.name: lst_imp_poa
decoys.desc: This tool returns every importer account listed on the power of attorney register. It supports checks that the brokerage is authorised to file for each client.

decoys.name: lst_imp_ctpat
decoys.desc: This tool returns every importer account enrolled on the trusted trader programme register. It supports planning around reduced inspection rates for those clients.

get_parent.name: get_imp_acct
get_parent.desc: This tool fetches the account file of a single importer using its unique identifier. It returns the importer's registered details as currently stored.

decoys.name: get_imp_bond
decoys.desc: This tool fetches the customs bond record of a single importer using its unique identifier. It returns the bond amount, surety, and renewal date on file.

decoys.name: get_imp_poa
decoys.desc: This tool fetches the power of attorney of a single importer using its unique identifier. It returns the signed authorisation the brokerage holds for that client.

decoys.name: get_imp_rulings
decoys.desc: This tool fetches the binding tariff rulings of a single importer using its unique identifier. It returns each classification ruling issued to that client.

delete_child.name: del_decl_rec
delete_child.desc: This tool permanently deletes a customs declaration record from the brokerage's system. The action cannot be undone, so it should be used with care.

decoys.name: wdr_decl_filing
decoys.desc: This tool permanently withdraws a customs declaration's electronic filing from the customs filing system. The action cannot be undone, so it should be used with care.

decoys.name: purge_decl_docs
decoys.desc: This tool permanently purges the scanned supporting documents attached to a customs declaration. The action cannot be undone, so it should be used with care.

decoys.name: rel_decl_bond
decoys.desc: This tool permanently releases the single-transaction bond posted against a customs declaration. The action cannot be undone, so it should be used with care.
verbs: free up the single-transaction bond for {obj}

set_enum.name: set_decl_st
set_enum.desc: This tool changes the customs clearance state of a declaration, moving it between pending, held, released, and seized. It should be used whenever customs updates a declaration's clearance status.

decoys.name: set_decl_pga
decoys.desc: This tool changes the partner agency clearance state of a declaration, moving it between pending, held, released, and seized. It should be used whenever a food or health agency updates its review.

decoys.name: set_decl_term
decoys.desc: This tool changes the terminal release state of a declaration, moving it between pending, held, released, and seized. It should be used whenever the port terminal updates the container's availability.

decoys.name: set_decl_carr
decoys.desc: This tool changes the carrier release state of a declaration, moving it between pending, held, released, and seized. It should be used whenever the shipping line updates its freight release.

set_bool.name: flag_hold
set_bool.desc: This tool places a customs hold on a declaration, preventing it from clearing until the hold is lifted. It is commonly used when a shipment's paperwork or cargo raises a concern.

decoys.name: flag_rush
decoys.desc: This tool places a rush priority on a declaration, moving it ahead in the filing queue until it clears. It is commonly used when a shipment carries perishable or time-critical goods.

decoys.name: flag_audit
decoys.desc: This tool places a compliance audit marker on a declaration, routing it to the audit desk until it is signed off. It is commonly used when a tariff classification looks unusual.

decoys.name: flag_split
decoys.desc: This tool places a split shipment marker on a declaration, keeping the entry open until every partial lot is received. It is commonly used when cargo arrives on several vessels.

set_ref.name: mv_decl
set_ref.desc: This tool reassigns a customs declaration's importer of record to another importer account. It is useful when a declaration was filed under the wrong client.

decoys.name: cnee_decl
decoys.desc: This tool reassigns a customs declaration's ultimate consignee to another importer account. It is useful when goods are sold on to a different client before arrival.

decoys.name: bill_decl
decoys.desc: This tool reassigns a customs declaration's duty billing to another importer account. It is useful when one client pays duty on behalf of a related company.

decoys.name: bond_decl
decoys.desc: This tool reassigns a customs declaration's bond coverage to another importer account. It is useful when a related company's continuous bond covers the entry.

send.name: ntfy_imp
send.desc: This tool sends a status notice to an importer regarding their account or a specific declaration. It is the standard way the brokerage communicates clearance changes.

decoys.name: inv_imp
decoys.desc: This tool sends a duty invoice to an importer regarding their account or a specific declaration. It is the standard way the brokerage bills duties and fees.
child_verbs: send a duty invoice to the importer on {obj}

decoys.name: req_imp
decoys.desc: This tool sends a document request to an importer regarding their account or a specific declaration. It is the standard way the brokerage chases missing paperwork.
child_verbs: request documents from the importer on {obj}
chase the importer for {obj} for paperwork

decoys.name: adv_imp
decoys.desc: This tool sends a compliance advisory to an importer regarding their account or a specific declaration. It is the standard way the brokerage announces regulatory changes.
child_verbs: send a compliance advisory to the importer on {obj}
advise the importer for {obj} of the rule change

create.name: new_decl
create.desc: This tool creates a new customs declaration for an importer, with an optional commodity and starting state. It is used when a shipment needs an entry opened with customs.

decoys.name: new_isf
decoys.desc: This tool creates a new security filing for an importer, with an optional commodity and starting state. It is used when ocean cargo must be declared before loading abroad.

decoys.name: new_rulreq
decoys.desc: This tool creates a new ruling request for an importer, with an optional commodity and starting state. It is used when a client wants a binding classification in advance.

decoys.name: new_drawbk
decoys.desc: This tool creates a new drawback claim for an importer, with an optional commodity and starting state. It is used when duty paid on imports is reclaimed after export.

list_notes.name: lst_decl_notes
list_notes.desc: This tool returns the broker notes attached to a single customs declaration. It includes every remark staff have logged against that entry.

decoys.name: lst_carrier_notes
decoys.desc: This tool returns the carrier notes attached to a single customs declaration. It includes every remark the shipping line has sent on that entry.

decoys.name: lst_decl_queries
decoys.desc: This tool returns the client queries attached to a single customs declaration. It includes every question the importer has raised on that entry.

decoys.name: lst_decl_findings
decoys.desc: This tool returns the audit findings attached to a single customs declaration. It includes every issue the compliance desk has recorded on that entry.

add_note.name: add_decl_note
add_note.desc: This tool attaches a new broker note to a customs declaration, with an optional title. It is used to record remarks about the entry's handling.

decoys.name: add_carrier_note
decoys.desc: This tool attaches a new carrier note to a customs declaration, with an optional title. It is used to record a remark passed on by the shipping line.

decoys.name: add_decl_finding
decoys.desc: This tool attaches a new audit finding to a customs declaration, with an optional title. It is used to record a compliance issue found on review.

decoys.name: add_decl_protest
decoys.desc: This tool attaches a new protest draft to a customs declaration, with an optional title. It is used to record grounds for disputing a customs decision.

update_note.name: chg_decl_note
update_note.desc: This tool changes the text, and optionally the title, of an existing note on a customs declaration. It is used to correct or expand a remark after it was logged.

decoys.name: ack_decl_note
decoys.desc: This tool acknowledges an existing note on a customs declaration with new text and an optional title. It is used when the importer confirms a remark on the entry.

decoys.name: close_decl_note
decoys.desc: This tool closes out an existing note on a customs declaration with new text and an optional title. It is used once the issue raised in the note is settled.

decoys.name: esc_decl_note
decoys.desc: This tool escalates an existing note on a customs declaration to the licensed broker with new text and an optional title. It is used when a remark needs sign-off.

delete_note.name: rm_decl_note
delete_note.desc: This tool permanently removes a broker note from a customs declaration. The note is erased from the brokerage's records for good.

decoys.name: rm_carrier_note
decoys.desc: This tool permanently removes a carrier note from a customs declaration. The note is erased from the brokerage's records for good.

decoys.name: redact_decl_note
decoys.desc: This tool permanently redacts the wording of a note on a customs declaration. The text is blacked out in the brokerage's records for good.

decoys.name: rm_decl_finding
decoys.desc: This tool permanently removes an audit finding from a customs declaration. The finding is erased from the brokerage's records for good.

set_image.name: set_decl_photo
set_image.desc: This tool sets the goods photo shown on a customs declaration record. It is typically a picture of the cargo or its packaging.

decoys.name: set_decl_label
decoys.desc: This tool sets the label photo shown on a customs declaration record. It is typically a picture of the country-of-origin marking.

decoys.name: set_decl_seal
decoys.desc: This tool sets the seal photo shown on a customs declaration record. It is typically a picture of the container seal at the terminal gate.

decoys.name: set_decl_bol
decoys.desc: This tool sets the bill of lading scan shown on a customs declaration record. It is typically the carrier's signed original.

writer.name: write_msg
writer.desc: This tool writes a short message from a brief, which states what to say in the requester's own words, and the declarations it should mention. It returns the finished text.

decoys.name: write_protest
decoys.desc: This tool writes a customs protest from a brief, which states the grounds in the broker's own words, and the declarations it should cover. It returns the finished text.

decoys.name: write_prior
decoys.desc: This tool writes a prior disclosure from a brief, which states the error in the client's own words, and the declarations it should cover. It returns the finished text.

decoys.name: write_advisory
decoys.desc: This tool writes a client advisory from a brief, which states the change in the broker's own words, and the declarations it should cite. It returns the finished text.

image.name: gen_photo
image.desc: This tool generates a shipment photo from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the result.

decoys.name: gen_label
decoys.desc: This tool generates a product label mockup from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the result.

decoys.name: gen_loadplan
decoys.desc: This tool generates a container load image from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the result.

decoys.name: gen_placard
decoys.desc: This tool generates a hazmat placard from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the result.

search.name: srch_guide
search.desc: This tool searches the brokerage software user guide with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up how the software works.

decoys.name: srch_tariff
decoys.desc: This tool searches the harmonized tariff schedule and its FAQ with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up a classification and duty rate.

decoys.name: srch_regs
decoys.desc: This tool searches the customs regulations and CBP help pages with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up a legal filing requirement.

decoys.name: srch_rulings
decoys.desc: This tool searches the published binding rulings with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up how similar goods were classified.
